scientific_integrity: The global result relies on a full analytic step-function optimization; computational checks independently verify finite covariance identities and sample feasible designs, but are not substituted for the global proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact Brownian-motion integral with independent Gaussian point errors and a fixed total precision budget. Does not establish optimality for nonlinear path measurements, adaptive sensors, non-Gaussian priors, or other objectives. Published noiseless Brownian quadrature design is acknowledged prior work; publication priority beyond inspected material remains uncertain.
title: Sharp joint precision and time design for Wiener-integral quadrature
